title: Prove key initializer semantics

original_mips_evidence.key_load: At VMA 0x080001D8 / ROM 0x6F36B8, the jalr delay slot loads an unsigned halfword from task +0xD4 into $a0.
original_mips_evidence.branch: At VMA 0x080001DC, beqz $v0 selects callback installation for a zero flag result; any nonzero result calls func_80034ED4_35AD4.
original_mips_evidence.callback_install: The zero-result path calls func_8003521C_35E1C with guest callback address 0x0800021C in its jalr delay slot.
original_mips_evidence.setter_store: At VMA 0x8003521C, func_8003521C_35E1C loads D_8016DAB4 and stores $a0 at current-task +0x0C in the jr delay slot.
original_mips_evidence.input_task_effect: The 96-byte initializer reads task +0xD4 and does not directly store to the supplied task object.
original_mips_evidence.finish_boundary: The host fixture verifies the initializer invokes the no-argument finish helper on nonzero; it does not model the helper's scheduler queue mutations.

host_fixture.design: The fixture models only the confirmed 32-bit callback slot at current-task +0x0C, with prefix/suffix sentinel bytes; it also snapshots the 0xD4 key-task view and passes a sentinel unused argument.
assertions: Zero flag result installs exactly callback guest address 0x0800021C and does not finish.
Nonzero flag result invokes finish once and does not invoke the callback setter.
Key-task bytes remain unchanged on both branches.
Current-task prefix/suffix sentinels remain unchanged; callback word changes only on the zero-result path.
host_fixture.negative_control: A temporary predicate mutant changed TEST_FLAG(...) != 0 to == 1; the fixture rejected it on the 0x10 result (assertion failure, nonzero exit).

current_full_rom_proof.reuse_reason: Only the host fixture changed. Production C, overlay staging, manifest and build inputs are unchanged; the current-target G2 already includes this exact overlay function.

mutant_rejection.command: Temporary equality-to-one predicate mutant compile/run; fixture expected a nonzero assertion exit.

limitations: No new G2 build was run for this host-only task; the current stored full-ROM proof was reused because production sources and manifest did not change.
The host fixture models the callback setter's single original 32-bit store and the finish-call boundary, not scheduler completion internals.
No game-memory write, key-spawn toolkit feature or in-game verification was performed.

publication.verification: Pushed without force; git ls-remote confirmed the task evidence commit.
